evaluationCost.note: evaluation cost; never added to arm cost

ARC-REV-01.rationale: Tier 2 still decides which copies are shelved at a branch (Catalog.copiesAt, reached through the existing Views.shelf projection) and what order each hold queue is in (Holds.queueFor). That includes the unknown-branch error, which comes from the existing shelf projection. Tier 3 only sorts the output, numbers queue positions and turns the existing DueBack option into CSV text. The CLI only sends commands to Reports and shows the returned views. No new domain rule is decided outside Tier 1/2.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: All three new exports write their files through the existing Files port and read state through the Store port. The change also removes an existing direct File.WriteAllLines call and the `open System.IO` from Tier 3 Reports, sending it through the port while keeping behaviour. It adds no effect in Tier 1/2, and presentation does not call Tier 2.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: Branch membership, queue order and loan due dates each come from one existing definition (Catalog.copiesAt, Holds.queueFor, library.Loans through Views.shelf). The shelf view gains a Book field instead of the export working the book out again. The member export reuses the existing Views.members projection. No limit, date rule or status derivation is copied.

evidence.quote: let waitingFor bookId (library: Library) = queueFor bookId library |> List.length

ARC-REV-01.rationale: Tier 2 decides whether a copy may be added: duplicate ids, known books and the branch (Catalog.addCopy, Catalog.findBranch). It also counts the holds waiting for a book (new Holds.waitingFor). Tier 3 importCopies only handles input: it skips the header and blank lines, splits fields, numbers lines and makes the import all or nothing by folding inside commit. Its `when copyId <> ""` field check treats a line with an empty copy id as malformed input rather than deciding a lending rule. The `HoldsWaiting > 0` choice in Reports only selects how a Tier 2 count is shown.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The new file read goes through the existing Files port, and saving goes through the existing commit/Store path. Tier 1/2 additions are pure functions over Library. The new CLI line only calls UseCases.importCopies. The `backup` line that uses JsonFileStore directly is existing context, not added by this change.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The number of holds on a book has one definition, Holds.waitingFor, built on the existing queueFor and used by the shelf projection. The export reads that value and does not count holds itself. The rules for copy uniqueness, known books and branches stay only in Catalog.addCopy and are not copied into the import.
